territorial_scope.description: Applies to electoral propaganda across Brazil, with some provisions specific to circumscriptions or municipal elections (e.g., Arts. 10 §6-B, 33-D).

evidence.quote: a partir do início da prestação do serviço de impulsionamento no Brasil

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Amends TSE Resolution 23.610/2019 on electoral propaganda in Brazil. Requires labelling of AI-generated political content, restricts manipulated content and deepfakes in campaigns, sets platform duties and paid-boosting rules, and imposes data-protection duties on campaigns. Takes effect on official publication (Art. 6).
summary.long: Amends TSE Resolution 23.610/2019 on electoral propaganda, in force on publication (Art. 6). Allows paid boosting (impulsionamento) of political content in pre-campaign only under cumulative conditions and bars its use for negative propaganda (Arts. 3-B, 29 §7-A). Requires explicit labelling of AI-generated or manipulated content (Art. 9-B) and bans manipulated content spreading notoriously false facts and deep fakes used to harm or favour candidacies (Art. 9-C §1); the deep-fake ban is treated as abuse of political power, with possible cassation of registration or mandate (Art. 9-C §2). Platforms must adopt measures against notoriously false content and are jointly liable, civilly and administratively, for not immediately removing content in listed risk cases during the electoral period (Arts. 9-D, 9-E). Boosting providers must keep a public ad repository and API access (Art. 27-A). Campaigns and platforms processing personal data must follow data-protection duties, keep processing records, and may be asked for impact reports in some elections (Arts. 33-B to 33-D). Paid online circulation of propaganda is barred from 48 hours before to 24 hours after elections (Art. 29 §11).

notes: Amending resolution: quoted provisions are new or substituted text of Res.-TSE 23.610/2019 (arts. 1, 3, 3-A to 3-C, 7, 9 to 9-H, 10, 13, 17, 23-A, 27-A, 28, 29, 29-A, 31, 33, 33-B to 33-D, 37, 38, 43, 55, 65, 68, 77). Restated unchanged text is not coded. Internal inconsistency: art. 33-B § 4º cites Lei nº 13.702/2018 for the data protection sanctions, while art. 33-B I and art. 33-D cite Lei nº 13.709/2018 for the same law; recorded as written, not corrected. Art. 1 quotes a new art. 33 paragraph that begins with a stray quotation mark and lacks a closing one; text recorded as printed. The document notes that it does not replace the text published in DJE-TSE nº 29 of 4.3.2024.

thresholds.variable_text: número de titulares de dados pessoais, em larga escala, equivalente ao eleitorado apto da circunscrição
thresholds.value_text: no mínimo, 10% (dez por cento) do eleitorado apto da circunscrição
thresholds.unit: percent of eligible electorate of the circumscription
thresholds.measurement: Number of data subjects whose personal data are processed, as a share of the circumscription's eligible electorate; the text does not specify the window or who measures it
thresholds.consequence: Together with criterion II (sensitive data or innovative/emerging technologies for profiling with a view to microtargeting), the processing is classed as high risk, for which the electoral authority may order a data protection impact report (Art. 33-D caput).
thresholds.conditions: Cumulative with § 1º, II of Art. 33-D (sensitive personal data or innovative or emerging technologies used for profiling of voters for microtargeting); applies to elections for President, Governor, Senator and state capital mayor.

evidence.quote: quando abranger número de titulares equivalente a, no mínimo, 10% (dez por cento) do eleitorado apto da circunscrição
